title: TREVCAN - Historical CAN Frames
description: Recorded raw CAN frames and decoded signals from the telemetry pipeline.

panels.title: CAN messages: recorded frames
panels.description: Every recorded raw/decoded CAN frame in the selected time range, filtered by DBC and bus.

panels.title: Captured frames per second
panels.description: Count of raw CAN frames exported to InfluxDB per second.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_frame" and r._field == "seq")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

panels.title: Inverter temperatures
panels.description: Works with the current temperature simulator; exact names depend on the chosen DBC.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "can_signal" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.signal =~ /^INV_.*(Temp|Temperature)/)
  |> group(columns: ["signal"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "signal"])
